profile.name: Vu Doan
profile.summary: Software engineer with 5 years on the frontend at a UK fintech, working in React, Svelte and TypeScript and building developer tooling that speeds up the team. Outside work, ships full-stack products with Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

experiences.summary: UK fintech building financial management software for the superyacht industry.
bullets: Build and maintain the production frontend in React, Svelte and TypeScript, including the shared Storybook component library, delivering features and fixes against release deadlines.

Built FE Quick Dev, a VSCode extension (TypeScript, Node.js) on the Visual Studio Marketplace that serves local builds into the live app, cutting a 3–10 minute deploy-to-test cycle to a near-instant rebuild. Used by 3 frontend engineers, plus a backend engineer moving into frontend work.

Built interaction-2-test, an open-source Storybook addon on npm that records UI interactions and generates the matching Jest test code, and a Bitbucket Forge app that triggers deployment pipelines on push.
Built Go and GraphQL services and a Python test-data generator for a group project: an A&E patient-wristband management system.

projects.title: InkPrint
projects.description: Turns hand-drawn glyphs into an installable font: compiles OTF files in the browser with opentype.js, stores them in R2 with metadata in Postgres, and syncs them to a companion browser extension that applies the font across every page, sharing sign-in between both apps.

projects.title: vudoan.vercel.app
projects.description: This portfolio and CV, backed by a self-built CMS: content in Redis, edited through an admin behind password and TOTP two-factor login, with Zod-validated server actions and tag-based cache revalidation.
